items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: Pluto — first just go Pluto Return. Then Pluto Return USA.

ctx.x: Well I’ve absolutely enjoyed this conversation and I’m going to have that Pluto thing on my mind.

Just check it out. Pluto — first just go Pluto Return. Then Pluto Return USA. Nobody ever has a Pluto Return in their own chart. You don’t live 248 years. But countries have Pluto Returns. So check it out. It’s heavy.
All right. Well you’re a heavy musician and thank you for sharing what you did today.
